senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָתַד) [leader of the flock,] ram.—Pl. עַתּוּדִים.
units: Num. R. s. 13 ואין ע׳ אלא לשון עמידה ʿattudim has the meaning of standing (readiness).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:7:10">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 27:26">Prov. XXVII, 26</cite>) <he>הגדילו ונעשו כע׳ וכ׳</he> when the pupils have grown and become (strong) like rams, then reveal to them the secrets of the Law.

<cite ref="Chullin 84a:23">Ḥull. 84ᵃ</cite> (ref. to Prov. l. c.) <he>לעולם … ויקח ע׳ וכ׳</he> at all times a man may sell a field and buy rams (flocks), but he should not sell flocks to buy a field; a. e.
